summary: Phase D (Chat) testing for Alpha Omega Phi portal. Backend: 18/20 pytest pass + 1 skip + 1 CRITICAL fail in /app/backend/tests/test_phase_d.py — chat-uploaded files cannot be downloaded via /api/files/{path} because /api/chat/upload writes to object storage but does NOT create a corresponding record in db.photos or db.documents, while /api/files only serves files registered in those two collections. All other chat endpoints (DM idempotency, group CRUD, messages, soft-delete, read state, WebSocket auth + push) work correctly. Frontend: all asks PASS — non-auth visits to /, /events, /chat, /directory all redirect to /login; logged-out navbar shows only logo + 10-Year Anniversary badge + 'Member login' (zero NavLinks); login page paragraph reads EXACTLY 'This is for Alpha Omega Phi members only. Once you complete Intake, you will be given access.'; after admin login navbar exposes 12 links including Chat; Home hero uses object-contain on navy bg with headline below image (no overlay/crop); /chat sidebar lists seed conversation, clicking opens thread, typing + Enter sends a text message that renders in the bubble; Chat link is visible at /chat.

critical.issue: Returns 404 for files uploaded via POST /api/chat/upload. chat_upload (server.py L3186) puts the object into storage at chat/{user_id}/{file_id}/{filename} but does NOT insert a record into db.photos or db.documents. download_file at L1509 only resolves files that exist in those two collections, so every chat attachment is unreachable via its returned url. Reproduces 100% — see test_phase_d.py::TestFileUpload::test_get_uploaded_file. Impact: chat image/file attachments will appear as broken thumbnails / failed downloads in the UI.

minor.issue: Self-removal via remove_member_ids is silently ignored (caller is re-added). Behaviour matches spirit of 'cannot remove yourself' but a 400 with a clear error would be more discoverable for API consumers.

ui_bugs.issue: Brand text 'Alpha Omega Phi' wraps to 3 lines at 1920px because the logo block is inside flex with 12 sibling NavLinks competing for space. The brand should use whitespace-nowrap or the LINKS row should be condensed.

The '+' (new chat) red FAB and the gear (conversation settings) button do not have data-testid attributes, making automated tests rely on text/icon selectors. Add data-testid='chat-new-btn' and data-testid='chat-settings-btn'.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 'WebSocket connection to wss://.../api/ws/chat failed: WebSocket is closed before the connection is established.' on first load. Backend WS works (verified via pytest with cookies). Likely caused by React StrictMode double-mount or useEffect cleanup closing the socket before the upgrade completes. Real-time delivery still works after the second connection establishes.
Inline images in chat bubbles WILL fail to render because the /api/files/{path} backend bug above causes GETs for chat attachments to 404. Composer upload + attach work; the display is broken.

issues: object-contain hero renders FULL image with letterboxing on navy background as required. Headline sits below the image.

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): /api/chat/upload must register the uploaded file so /api/files/{path} can serve it. Two options: (a) add an insert into db.documents (or a dedicated db.chat_files collection) inside chat_upload with {storage_path, content_type, uploaded_by, conversation_id (optional), is_deleted:false}, OR (b) extend download_file to also resolve storage_path against db.chat_files / authorize members of the conversation when storage_path starts with 'chat/'. Option (a) is the minimal change.
Add data-testid='chat-new-btn' to the red '+' FAB in /app/frontend/src/pages/Chat.jsx and data-testid='chat-settings-btn' to the gear button in the conversation header for testability.
Consider returning 400 on PUT /conversations/{id} when remove_member_ids contains the caller (currently silent no-op).
Consider adding whitespace-nowrap to the brand span in Navbar.jsx (line 53) so 'Alpha Omega Phi' stays on one line at typical desktop widths.
Optional: investigate WebSocket close-before-open warning — likely benign StrictMode double-mount.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3274 lines — Phase D adds another 380+ lines on top. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (chat_router.py, fraternity_router.py, etc.) per the >700-line code-review threshold.

chat_upload buffers entire 100MB file in memory before flushing to object storage (chunks list joined to bytes). For real 100MB uploads this is a 100MB+ memory spike per concurrent upload — stream directly to storage instead.
/api/chat/upload returns url='/api/files/...' but does NOT register the file anywhere, so the URL is permanently dead (see CRITICAL bug). This is a contract mismatch that broke the integration.
ChatHub keeps a dict of user_id -> list[WebSocket] in process memory — fine for single-replica, but will silently drop fan-out when scaled horizontally. Acceptable for MVP, document for future.
delete_conversation deletes messages but does NOT delete uploaded files from object storage — orphaned blobs will accumulate.

WebSocket route accepts cookie but does not also accept ?token= query param, which makes WS testing from non-browser clients require building Cookie header manually. Consider supporting both for resilience.

success_rate.backend: 90% (18/20 phase D, 1 skip, 1 critical fail). Phase A/B/C endpoints used by Chat (auth, members listing) still alive.
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 4 Phase D frontend asks (redirects, login paragraph, hero, navbar+chat). Real-time WS delivery verified server-side.

There is a seed conversation between admin and Riley Chen / member from earlier smoke tests — don't delete it.
rca of the issue: Chat uploaded files 404 RCA: server.py defines a single /api/files/{storage_path:path} route (L1509) that resolves the storage path against ONLY db.photos and db.documents, requiring is_deleted!=true. Phase D adds /api/chat/upload (L3186) which uses the same /api/files/... URL prefix in its response but skips the DB registration step entirely (only put_object is called). Therefore every chat attachment's url returns 404 on download even though the bytes exist in object storage. Mitigation (option A, minimal): inside chat_upload, after put_object succeeds, also insert into db.documents (or a new db.chat_files collection) a record like {id: file_id, storage_path, filename, content_type, uploaded_by: user['id'], conversation_id: None, is_deleted: False, created_at: now_iso()}. Reusing db.documents would make the existing /files/{path} resolver work without any changes. For stricter access control, create a new db.chat_files collection and extend the /files resolver to additionally look in it AND verify the caller is a member of any conversation referencing this file_id. Reproduction: POST /api/chat/upload with any small file then GET /api/files/<returned_url path> -> 404 {'detail': 'File not found'}.
